reason: My bookkeeper already puts everything into the app we use and it works well enough. A second sheet running next to it means two places to check, not one. I might throw the free 30 receipts at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $19 a month to have my spending in two places.
objection: Most of my mechanics get paid cash, and their 'receipt' is a scribbled note or nothing at all. Same part, same price, every week. I don't believe a bot can tell a real duplicate from two genuine oil changes on two scooters, so I'd end up checking it all myself anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it sent the rows straight into the app my bookkeeper already uses instead of its own Google Sheet, and in the free trial it actually caught a double-paid repair from my own chat.
